title: Scaling at Chiral Clock Criticality via Entanglement Renormalization
abstract: We employ the Multiscale Entanglement Renormalization Ansatz (MERA) to study the Z3 chiral clock model. Using the variational principle to construct a MERA representation of the model's ground state, we extract scaling dimensions and critical exponents along the critical line. We investigate how scaling data evolves across the critical line as the chiral parameter varies, demonstrating MERA's effectiveness in capturing the complex low-energy physics of the chiral clock model.
key_claims: MERA accurately extracts scaling dimensions and critical exponents along the Z3 chiral clock critical line
Demonstrates MERA's effectiveness beyond Ising CFT to Z3 universality classes
Variational MERA captures complex low-energy physics including chiral deformations
Provides methodological template for applying MERA to non-Ising CFTs relevant to holography
Brian Swingle co-author -- same group as holographic entanglement paper 2601.21065
